content.short: 900 unique, AI-generated portraits based on a painting of Ada Lovelace.
content.description: All Adaz are based off of the Portrait of Ada Lovelace by Alfred Edward Chalon around 1838. Using an advanced machine learning algorithm, 900 new portraits were created. If you manage to collect all 5 Adaz of a bloodline, you will be able to mint one of 100 animated Adaz bloodline NFTs.
